statement: Open Dynamo from the Manage tab to build graphs of nodes connected by wires that automate Revit workflows, including Revit-specific nodes that act on model elements.
superiority: Provide one visual graph engine for geometry, data and BIM with debugging and profiling.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Page only introduces Dynamo as a graphical programming interface; editor details are in the external Dynamo Primer which is not reachable. Acceptance sketch: A graph that creates 10 columns on a grid produces ten columns at the computed positions.

statement: Dynamo for Revit supplies node groups for selection, elements, families, views, sheets, tags, dimensions, parameters, documents and more that select, create and edit Revit elements.
superiority: Native nodes for every operator so no third-party package is needed.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Page lists node categories (Selection, Element, Sheet, View, Tag, Dimension, Toposolid, etc.). Acceptance sketch: Node sets a parameter on selected walls and values read back.

statement: Lists with shortest, longest and cross-product lacing control iteration.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Lists and Lacing

superiority: Show lacing outcomes visually before running.
notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo topics (lacing, list, Dynamo, dynamo graph) and Revit help; lists/lacing are documented only in the Dynamo Primer (external, not reachable). Acceptance sketch: Cross-product lacing on 3x4 lists produces 12 results.

statement: Embed Python script nodes with access to the document and API.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Python Nodes

notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo topics for python/script; only Steel Connections debug examples appear, no page documenting Python script nodes (Dynamo Primer is external and unreachable). Acceptance sketch: Python node returns computed values.

statement: Write concise expressions and functions in code block nodes using DesignScript.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Code Blocks and DesignScript

superiority: Typed expression language with unit checks.
notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo topics and Revit help for code block/DesignScript; no page found (documented in external Dynamo Primer/Dictionary). Acceptance sketch: Range expression produces the expected list.

statement: Package a graph into a reusable custom node with inputs and outputs.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Custom Nodes

notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo topics for custom node; only Graph Dependencies mentions custom nodes as dependencies. Creation of custom nodes is documented externally. Acceptance sketch: Custom node behaves as the source graph.

statement: Graphs depend on packages, which are collections of custom nodes that extend Dynamo, and a missing or mismatched package version can be installed or fixed from the Workspace References extension.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Revit help documents packages only as graph dependencies and install of a specified version; browsing a community package manager is documented externally. Acceptance sketch: Package installs and its nodes appear.

statement: Dynamo Player lists graphs from chosen directories with thumbnails, search and status, runs them with a play button, prompts for graph inputs in a dialog and offers an Edit in Dynamo option.
superiority: Publish graphs as apps with typed inputs.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Editing a graph from Player is available, so it is not strictly no-graph-editing. Acceptance sketch: Script runs with entered input.

statement: Run graphs from a command line or from a cloud work item for batch processing.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Automation and Headless Run

superiority: Same runtime in desktop and cloud.
notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched Revit help and RevitDynamo topics (command line, headless, work item); only Revit install/server command-line pages and Player pages found. Design Automation docs on aps.autodesk.com load as a JavaScript shell without text content. Acceptance sketch: Headless run of a graph on 5 files produces output files.

statement: Create and transform points, curves, surfaces and solids in the graph.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Geometry Library

superiority: Use the same exact kernel as the host app.
notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo topics and Revit help for the Dynamo geometry library; only Revit-specific node pages (GeometryReferences, T-Spline, etc.) exist, the core geometry library is documented in the external Dynamo Dictionary. Acceptance sketch: A sphere solid volume equals 4/3 pi r^3.

statement: Track elements created by a graph so reruns update rather than duplicate them.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Revit Element Binding

superiority: Stable identity with explicit lifetime handling.
notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo and Revit help (binding, element tracking); 'Binding' hits are the Revit API shared-parameter binding, unrelated. Dynamo-Revit element binding is documented outside the indexed help. Acceptance sketch: Rerunning with changed input updates the same elements.

statement: Inspect node outputs, previews and errors in the graph.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Watch and Debug

notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo topics; only the Player Issue Viewer (errors/warnings list with CSV export) and Steel Connections debug pages exist. Watch node and preview inspection are documented externally. Acceptance sketch: Watch shows each node's value.

statement: Each Revit release removes or deprecates some Dynamo for Revit nodes with named replacements, and Dynamo Player always uses the Dynamo version installed with that Revit, so graphs may need updating.
superiority: Stable graph format with automatic migration.
notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Node Changes lists removed and deprecated nodes per release (2026, 2027). Acceptance sketch: Graph from the previous release opens and runs.

statement: Exchange geometry and data with Rhino/Grasshopper workflows through bridges.

source.ref: Dynamo to Rhino and Grasshopper Bridges
source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo to Rhino and Grasshopper Bridges

notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched Revit and RevitDynamo help for Rhino and Grasshopper; no Autodesk page found. Any Rhino/Grasshopper bridge is third-party or package-based, so not a documented Revit feature. Acceptance sketch: Geometry round trips.

statement: Measure per-node execution time and list sizes so slow graph sections can be found.

source.doc: https://help.autodesk.com/view/RVT/2027/ENU/ ; Revit 2027 Help topic: Dynamo: Graph Profiling

superiority: Show profiler results directly on the canvas with suggestions.
notes: UNVERIFIED 2026-11-14: Searched RevitDynamo topics for profiling and execution time; nothing found. Possibly an external Dynamo feature. Acceptance sketch: Profile reports a time for every node in a 200-node graph.

statement: Graphs from untrusted folders are blocked until trusted for one session or permanently via a trusted locations list managed in preferences.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register Acceptance sketch: Open a graph from an untrusted folder, confirm the run is blocked, grant one-time trust, and verify the warning returns next time.

statement: From any node port, a suggestion list of compatible nodes, ranked by recommended nodes or type match, can be previewed and wired automatically.
superiority: Suggestions that understand the current Revit document context.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register Acceptance sketch: Trigger from an output port and confirm ranked suggestions wire on click, with both ranking modes selectable.

statement: An issue viewer lists errors, warnings and missing inputs from a graph run with search and CSV export including node names and message links.
superiority: Click an issue to select the offending node in the graph.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-14: feature found documented in Revit 2027 help during the verification pass; not in the original register Acceptance sketch: Run a graph with a warning, open the viewer, search a title and export the CSV.
